sloka: मोहिता तपसा तस्य तेजसा मंदरश्मयः ।कश्मल उपहताः सर्वे पितामहम् अथ अब्रुवन् ॥१-६५-१०॥
transliteration: mohitā tapasā tasya tejasā maṁdaraśmayaḥ ।kaśmala upahatāḥ sarve pitāmaham atha abruvan ॥1-65-10॥

translations.english: "O Lord the great sage Viswamitra was lured and angered in various ways. But his austerities continued to grow:
